answer: Challenge-Bound Identity Minting. Each agent identity is created by solving a freshly generated, non-reusable challenge derived from live network entropy, such as a rotating plume of peer beacons. The solution seeds a unique keypair recorded in a nebula of replicated ledgers, so replaying a prior answer fails validation. A prism of independent verifiers checks novelty before issuance. Attacker cost: one full computation plus storage proof per identity, non-amortizable across clones.
